knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A plugged-in unit is unplugged before any cleaning or clearing. Wetting or solvents are not used.
Dry cloths are used on the cutters. Greases and abrasives damage the mechanism and are not used.
A jammed unit is reported to the site contact. Forcing it can break it.

practicalCriteria: Unplugs the sharpener first, then empties the receptacle over the collection bin.
Clears lodged material from the cutters using a dry cloth and a blunt tool, and returns the unit to its place working.
Reports a unit that will not clear, with its location, instead of forcing it.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of one sharpener clean
stopWorkCriteria: Oil, grease or abrasive used on cutters
